entry.content:
Email

Email: ltsLeoliu@gmail.com

1. Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how Tap EMU (“we,” “our,” or “us”) handles information when you use our emulator application for iOS and Android (“App”). Tap EMU lets you import game files you have the right to use, play them with on-screen controls, keep saves on your device, and optionally subscribe to VIP.

We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy describes what stays on your device, what is sent to third-party services, and what we do not collect on our own servers.

See our Terms of Use for the rules on game files, subscriptions, and acceptable use.

2. Our Privacy Principles

Tap EMU is built with a local-first approach:

  • No user accounts: We do not require registration, login, or a centralized profile.
  • Your library stays on your device: Game files you import, covers, saves, controller skins, and playtime are stored locally unless you choose a feature that needs the internet.
  • We do not upload your game files for analytics: The bytes of a ROM, save, or skin are not sent to Firebase.
  • No payment card storage: Purchases are handled by Apple or Google. We do not collect your card number.

3. Information We Do NOT Collect on Our Servers

We do not:

  • Require your name, email address, phone number, or other account identifiers (unless you voluntarily contact support)
  • Collect or store payment card or banking information
  • Upload the contents of a ROM, save file, or controller skin to our own analytics
  • Operate a cloud backup of your library
  • Request microphone access

4. Information Stored on Your Device

The following data is stored locally on your device:

  • Library: Imported game files, the names you give them, covers, and related library metadata
  • Saves: In-game battery saves, quick saves, and auto saves
  • Skins: Controller skins you select, create, or import, including photos you use as a cover or skin
  • Playtime and settings: Cumulative playtime, onboarding progress, language, mute, and similar preferences
  • Subscription entitlement cache: A local record of whether VIP is active (no payment details)

This data remains on your device until you delete it, uninstall the App, or reset your device. If you use your device’s own backup, that backup is controlled by Apple, Google, or you, not by a Tap EMU account.

5. Game Files

Tap EMU is a player. It does not grant you any right to a third-party game.

  • Files you import from the Files app or another app are copied onto your device. We do not receive those file contents on a Tap EMU server.
  • If you choose to download a file from a list inside the App, the App requests that file over HTTPS from our file host. The request uses the file name. The file is then stored on your device.
  • You may import or download a file only if you already have the legal right to use it. See the Terms of Use.

6. Photos and the Camera

The camera and photo library are used only so you can take or choose a picture for a custom cover or controller skin.

  • Those images are stored on your device
  • They are not uploaded to a Tap EMU server
  • The App does not give us ongoing access to your camera or photo library. You choose each image

7. Third-Party SDKs and Services

Tap EMU integrates third-party services. These are not Tap EMU user-account servers. They may process certain data according to their own privacy policies:

ServicePurposeData Involved
Google AdMobRewarded, app-open, banner, and interstitial adsAdvertising identifiers, ad interaction data, and, if the system allows it, location used to make ads more relevant
Firebase AnalyticsProduct analytics, on Android in the current releaseApp events such as onboarding, play sessions, paywall steps, and feature use. ROM contents are not attached. A catalog download event may include the catalog file name
Firebase Remote ConfigFeature limits such as daily free-play time, on Android in the current releaseA configuration fetch. Your library is not uploaded
Apple App Store / Google PlaySubscriptions and purchasesPurchase receipts and entitlement status, handled by Apple or Google
Our file hostA file you choose to download from an in-app listThe file name needed to fetch that file

The current iOS release does not initialize Firebase. Analytics events and Remote Config fetches are not sent from that iOS build. Android may send the Firebase data described above.

Links to third-party privacy policies:

  • Google Privacy Policy
  • Firebase Privacy
  • Apple Privacy

8. Advertising

Free play may include advertisements served by Google AdMob, including banner ads, interstitial ads, app-open ads, and rewarded ads that can add play time. VIP reduces or removes these interruptions, as described in the App.

AdMob may use device advertising identifiers and interaction data to serve and measure ads, in accordance with Google’s policies. On iOS, Tap EMU participates in Apple’s SKAdNetwork for ad attribution. You can limit ad tracking in your device settings.

The App declares location access so advertising services can show more relevant ads if you grant that permission. We do not build our own location history.

9. Analytics

On Android, we use Firebase Analytics to understand how the App is used, such as sessions, imports, play sessions, skins, and subscription steps, and Firebase Remote Config to read limits such as daily free-play time.

These reports are processed by Google Firebase, not stored as a Tap EMU user profile. Game-file contents, save contents, and photos are not sent to Firebase. You can learn more at Firebase Privacy.

10. Permissions

The App may request the following permissions:

PermissionWhy We Ask
CameraTake a photo for a custom cover or controller skin
Photo LibraryChoose an existing photo for a custom cover or controller skin
Files / storageImport a game file, skin, or save that you select
LocationAllow advertising services to show more relevant ads, if you grant access
Advertising identifierServe and measure ads on Android
InternetLoad ads, complete a store purchase, and download a file you choose from an in-app list

Tap EMU does not request microphone access.

11. Children’s Privacy

Tap EMU is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided information through the App, contact us at ltsLeoliu@gmail.com.

12. Data Retention

12.1 Local Data

Your library, saves, skins, and settings remain on your device until you:

  • Delete an item inside the App
  • Uninstall the App
  • Reset or replace your device

12.2 Third-Party Processing

  • AdMob and Firebase: Retain ad and analytics data under Google’s policies.
  • Apple and Google: Retain purchase records under their policies.
  • File host: Processes the download request you start. We do not keep a Tap EMU account copy of files you imported from outside the App.

13. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on your region, you may have rights regarding your personal information. Because Tap EMU stores most data locally:

  • Access and deletion: You can delete games, saves, and skins in the App, or remove App data by uninstalling.
  • Photos: A photo is used only when you choose it for a cover or skin.
  • Ads and analytics: You can limit ad tracking through your device settings. VIP reduces ad interruptions inside the App.
  • Purchases: Manage or cancel a subscription in the App Store or Google Play, and restore a purchase from the VIP screen.
  • Contact us: For privacy requests, email ltsLeoliu@gmail.com.

If you are in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or California, you may have additional rights under the GDPR, UK GDPR, or CCPA, including access, correction, deletion, and the right to appeal a denial. Contact us and we will respond within a reasonable time.

14. International Data Transfers

AdMob and Firebase are operated by Google and may process data outside your country. A file you choose to download is requested over HTTPS and may be served from a host outside your country. Apple and Google process purchases in the regions where those stores operate.

15. Security

Tap EMU uses:

  • Local storage for your library, saves, skins, and settings
  • HTTPS for requests to third-party services and for a file you choose to download

Your data also depends on your device: a passcode or biometrics, current system updates, and how you back the device up.

16. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The new version will be posted on this page with a new date. If you keep using the App after the update is posted, the updated policy applies to that use.

17. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:

Email: ltsLeoliu@gmail.com

Tap EMU keeps your library on your device, does not require an account, and does not upload your game files for analytics.

entry.content:
Email

Email: vomiv523@gmail.com

1. Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how Easebite (“we,” “our,” or “us”) handles information when you use our meal companion application for iOS and Android (“App”). Easebite helps you photograph a meal, see one small adjustment that may be easier on your stomach, note how you felt afterward, and keep an optional eating rhythm while you chew.

We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy describes what stays on your device, what is sent to third-party services, and what we do not collect on our own servers.

Easebite is not a medical device. See our Terms of Use for the limits of meal suggestions, allergy notes, and the eating rhythm.

2. Our Privacy Principles

Easebite is built with a local-first, no-backend approach:

  • No proprietary servers: We do not operate backend servers to store or aggregate your meals, photos, symptoms, or profile.
  • No user accounts: We do not require registration, login, or a centralized user profile.
  • Your meal data stays on your device: Photos, food notes, after-meal feelings, allergies, and chew counts are stored locally unless you explicitly use a feature that needs the internet.
  • User-initiated meal analysis only: A meal photo is sent for recognition only when you choose to analyze that meal.
  • Chewing stays on the device: The eating-rhythm camera counts chews on your phone. Face frames are not uploaded.
  • No location tracking: Easebite does not request your location.

3. Information We Do NOT Collect on Our Servers

Because Easebite has no backend for your content, we do not:

  • Operate servers that store your meal photos, meal records, symptom answers, or allergy list
  • Maintain a cloud backup or sync service for your meals
  • Require your name, email address, phone number, or other account identifiers (unless you voluntarily contact support)
  • Collect or store payment card or banking information (purchases are handled entirely by Apple or Google)
  • Collect your precise location
  • Record or upload microphone audio (the App does not request microphone access)
  • Upload camera frames or face geometry from the eating-rhythm screen
  • Use face data to identify who you are

4. Information Stored on Your Device

The following data is stored locally on your device:

  • Profile: The stomach focus you choose (such as reflux, bloating, both, or none), foods you say tend to bother you, foods you say are usually fine, food allergies you enter, and an optional bedtime
  • Meal records: The time of an analysis, recognized food names, the small adjustment shown for that meal, an optional note you type, and the local path of the meal photo
  • After-meal feelings: Your answers about reflux, bloating, stomach pain, nausea, burning in the chest, and feeling full after eating a little, including how strong a “yes” felt
  • Discomfort summary: A short paragraph derived from meals you have already rated, kept so a later photo can take that pattern into account
  • Chew counts: How many chews were kept during an eating-rhythm sitting, and when that sitting started. These counts are not written into the meal record and are not turned into a health score
  • App settings: Notification preference, onboarding progress, and whether you have seen the in-app privacy note
  • Subscription entitlement cache: A local record of your premium status (no payment details)

This data remains on your device until you delete it, uninstall the App, or reset your device.

5. Meal Photos and AI Analysis

5.1 Local Photo Storage

Meal photos you capture or choose from your library are stored locally on your device. Easebite does not upload those photos to our own servers.

5.2 When a Photo Is Sent

A photo is transmitted only when you choose to analyze that meal. The photo is sent over a secure connection to Alibaba DashScope (vision models) so the App can name visible foods and suggest one small adjustment.

Along with that photo, the request may include:

  • The symptom focus you selected, foods you listed for that symptom, and allergies you entered
  • The discomfort summary already saved on your phone, when one exists
  • The local time of the meal
  • An optional note you typed about the meal
  • Your app language, so names and sentences come back in that language

Your bedtime, and the raw list of past meals, are not attached to this photo request. Past meals affect the request only through the saved discomfort summary described in Section 6.

The App does not give DashScope ongoing access to your photo library. You choose each photo.

Analysis results are returned to your device and stored locally. Retention of data processed by DashScope is governed by Alibaba Cloud’s policies.

5.3 What the Analysis Is For

The model looks at the meal you submitted and the stomach notes included with that request. It suggests a small, practical adjustment. It does not diagnose a condition, and an allergy note is not a statement that the rest of the meal is safe. A photo may not show every ingredient.

6. After-Meal Feelings

Feelings you record stay on your device.

If you have rated more than one meal and the same food appears in two of those rated meals, a text-only request may be sent to DashScope to mark which foods lined up with a symptom. That request includes food names, the local time of those meals, and whether each symptom was yes or no. It does not include the meal photo.

If no food repeats across rated meals, that comparison stays on your device and is not sent for this text analysis.

The resulting summary is saved locally and may be included the next time you analyze a photo, as described in Section 5.2.

7. Eating Rhythm and the Camera

The eating-rhythm screen uses the camera and an on-device face mesh to notice chewing motion and light one step of the ring per chew.

  • Processing runs on your device
  • Camera frames and face landmarks are not uploaded and are not saved as photos
  • The feature does not identify you and is not used for advertising
  • Only a chew count and the time of that sitting are kept locally
  • The rhythm is a companion while you eat. It is not a chewing standard and does not produce a symptom conclusion

8. Notifications

Reminders are scheduled on your device. We do not operate a push server for them.

If you leave notifications on, the App may schedule:

  • A reminder after a meal, asking you to note how you felt
  • After two days without a meal analysis, a daily reminder around meal times learned from the times of your past analyses

Those times stay on your device. Notification text does not include your food names, symptoms, or allergies.

9. Third-Party SDKs and Services

Easebite integrates third-party services. These are not Easebite-owned servers. They may process certain data according to their own privacy policies:

ServicePurposeData Involved
Alibaba DashScopeMeal recognition and a small adjustment; text comparison when one food repeats across rated mealsThe meal photo you submit, the stomach notes listed in Section 5.2, and the text described in Section 6
Firebase AnalyticsProduct analyticsApp events and device or app identifiers. Meal photos, symptom answers, and allergy lists are not sent
Firebase CrashlyticsCrash and error reportingCrash logs and device state. Meal content is not attached
Google AdMobRewarded ads that free users may watch before a meal analysisAdvertising identifiers and ad interaction data
Apple App Store / Google PlaySubscriptions and purchasesPurchase receipts, handled by Apple or Google

Links to third-party privacy policies:

  • Google Privacy Policy
  • Firebase Privacy
  • Alibaba Cloud Legal
  • Apple Privacy

10. Advertising

Free users may be asked to watch a rewarded video ad, served by Google AdMob, before a meal analysis. Subscribers continue without that step. AdMob may use device advertising identifiers and interaction data to serve and measure ads, in accordance with Google’s policies.

On iOS, Easebite may participate in Apple’s SKAdNetwork for ad attribution. You can limit ad tracking in your device settings.

11. Analytics and Crash Reporting

We initialize Firebase Analytics to understand how the App is used, such as sessions and feature usage, and Firebase Crashlytics to collect fatal crashes so we can fix stability issues. Crash reports may include device model, OS version, and stack traces.

These reports are processed by Google Firebase, not stored on Easebite servers. Meal photos, the foods you listed, symptom answers, and allergies are not sent to Firebase. You can learn more at Firebase Privacy.

12. Permissions

The App may request the following permissions:

PermissionWhy We Ask
CameraPhotograph a meal, and count chews on the eating-rhythm screen
Photo LibraryChoose an existing meal photo
NotificationsLocal reminders to note how a meal felt, and to come back around your usual meal times
InternetSend a meal you chose to analyze, contact ad and analytics services, and complete a store purchase

Easebite does not request location or microphone access. On Android, notification and boot-completed access are used only to deliver and restore the local reminders above.

13. Health Information

Profile choices, allergy names, and after-meal feelings are information about your body. They are stored on your device and are shared only as described in Sections 5 and 6, when you analyze a meal or when a repeated food is compared.

We do not use this information to advertise to you, and we do not sell it.

14. Children’s Privacy

Easebite is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided information through the App, contact us at vomiv523@gmail.com.

15. Data Retention

15.1 Local Data

Your meals, photos, feelings, and profile remain on your device until you:

  • Delete a meal inside the App
  • Uninstall the App
  • Reset or replace your device

15.2 Third-Party Processing

  • DashScope: Processes the photo or text you submit for that request. Retention is subject to Alibaba Cloud’s policies.
  • Firebase and AdMob: Retain analytics, crash, and ad data under Google’s policies.

We do not keep long-term copies of your meals on Easebite servers.

16. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on your region, you may have rights regarding your personal information. Because Easebite stores most data locally:

  • Access and deletion: You can review and delete meals in the App, change your profile, or remove App data by uninstalling.
  • Meal analysis: A photo is sent only when you choose to analyze that meal.
  • Feelings: You can skip a feeling card. The text comparison in Section 6 runs only after you have saved feelings and one food repeats.
  • Notifications: You can turn reminders off in Settings.
  • Ads and analytics: You can limit ad tracking through your device settings.
  • Purchases: Manage or cancel a subscription in the App Store or Google Play.
  • Contact us: For privacy requests, email vomiv523@gmail.com.

If you are in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or California, you may have additional rights under the GDPR, UK GDPR, or CCPA, including access, correction, deletion, and the right to appeal a denial. Contact us and we will respond within a reasonable time.

17. International Data Transfers

When you analyze a meal, or when a repeated food is compared, that request may be processed by DashScope in mainland China, Singapore, or the United States. Firebase and AdMob are operated by Google and may process data outside your country. We use HTTPS for these requests.

18. Security

Easebite uses:

  • Local storage for meals, photos, feelings, and chew counts
  • HTTPS for requests to third-party services
  • Device secure storage for credentials the App needs to call DashScope

Your data also depends on your device: a passcode or biometrics, current system updates, and how you back the device up.

19. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The new version will be posted on this page with a new date. If you keep using the App after the update is posted, the updated policy applies to that use.

20. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:

Email: vomiv523@gmail.com

Easebite keeps your meals on your device, sends a photo only when you analyze that meal, and counts chews without uploading your face.

Easebite is a meal companion for iOS and Android. You can:

Easebite is an informational companion. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

Meal suggestions, food names, and patterns drawn from your after-meal notes:

  • Are not a reason to start, stop, or change medication, or to ignore symptoms
  • Do not replace a doctor, dietitian, or allergist

Symptoms. Reflux, bloating, pain, nausea, burning, and early fullness can have causes the App cannot see. Seek medical care for severe, persistent, or worsening symptoms, and for any emergency.

Eating rhythm. One circle is one bite and one step is one chew. You can stop at any time. The rhythm is not a chewing quota, not a score, and not a judgment of how you ate.

You agree to use the App only for lawful personal purposes, and you are responsible for:

  • Keeping your device secure
  • Making sure photos and notes you add are lawful and are yours to use
  • Not reverse engineering, decompiling, or modifying the App

  • Decisions you make about what to eat

1. Introduction

This Privacy Policy explains how HortiWise (“we,” “our,” or “us”) handles information when you use our plant care companion application for iOS and Android (“App”). HortiWise is designed to help you track plants, receive care reminders, and get AI-assisted identification and health insights.

We are committed to protecting your privacy. This policy describes what data stays on your device, what is sent to third-party services, and what we do not collect on our own servers.

2. Our Privacy Principles

HortiWise is built with a local-first, no-backend approach:

  • No proprietary servers: We do not operate backend servers to store or aggregate your garden data.
  • No user accounts: We do not require registration, login, or a centralized user profile.
  • Your garden data stays on your device: Plant profiles, journals, photos, and care plans are stored locally unless you explicitly trigger a feature that requires internet access.
  • User-initiated AI only: Plant photos are sent for analysis only when you tap Identify or Health Check.
  • Location for weather only: Location, postal code, or IP-based approximation is used solely to fetch weather forecasts and watering suggestions — not for background tracking or advertising targeting.

3. Information We Do NOT Collect on Our Servers

Because HortiWise has no backend infrastructure, we do not:

  • Operate servers that store your plant photos, journals, or garden records
  • Maintain a cloud backup or sync service for your garden data
  • Collect your name, email address, phone number, or other personal identifiers (unless you voluntarily contact support)
  • Collect or store payment card or banking information (purchases are handled entirely by Apple or Google)
  • Track your precise home address in the background

4. Information Stored on Your Device

The following data is stored locally on your device:

  • Plant profiles: Names, types, environment settings, care schedules, and watering history
  • Garden journal entries: Notes, health check results, and optional journal photos
  • Plant photos: Saved in your device’s local app storage (not on HortiWise servers)
  • Location preferences: City, region, country, postal code, and approximate coordinates used for weather (cached locally for convenience)
  • Care plans and task recommendations: Generated care schedules and feedback
  • App settings: Notification preferences, unit settings (metric/imperial), onboarding status
  • Subscription entitlement cache: A local record of your premium status (no payment details)

This data remains on your device until you delete it, uninstall the App, or reset your device.

5. AI Analysis and Photos

5.1 Local Photo Storage

Plant photos you capture or select are stored locally on your device. HortiWise does not upload photos to our own servers.

5.2 When Photos Are Sent to AI

Photos are transmitted only when you actively request AI features:

  • Plant Identification: When you tap Identify
  • Health Check: When you tap Health Check and submit a photo for analysis

In these cases, your photo is temporarily sent over a secure connection to Alibaba DashScope (Qwen VL models) for processing. Analysis results are returned to your device and stored locally.

Photos are not sent for identification or health analysis unless you tap the relevant action. This is also shown in the App: “Photos are sent for identification only when you tap Identify.”

5.3 What AI Processes

The AI analysis:

  • Processes only the plant images you choose to submit
  • Provides identification suggestions, health scores, and care recommendations
  • Does not give DashScope or HortiWise ongoing access to your entire photo library
  • Is performed through secure API calls; we do not permanently store your photos on HortiWise servers

Retention of data processed by DashScope is governed by Alibaba Cloud’s policies.

6. Location and Weather

HortiWise uses location-related information only to provide weather-based care suggestions:

  • GPS coordinates (when you grant location permission)
  • Postal code (when you enter it manually)
  • IP-based approximate location (when no GPS or postal code is set, via weather providers)

This information is sent to WeatherAPI.com and/or QWeather (Hefeng) to retrieve forecasts. We do not use location for background tracking, advertising targeting, or building location profiles.

A summary of your location preference (city, region, approximate coordinates) may be cached locally on your device for faster weather updates.

7. Voice Features

HortiWise includes voice interaction for garden commands:

  • On-device speech recognition: When available, speech-to-text runs on your device using Apple’s or Google’s speech recognition services.
  • Cloud AI routing (when enabled): If you use voice commands that require AI interpretation, your transcribed text (not raw audio stored by us) and relevant garden context (such as plant names) may be sent to DashScope to determine your intent.

We do not operate servers to store your voice recordings.

8. Third-Party SDKs and Services

HortiWise integrates third-party services. These are not HortiWise-owned servers, but they may process certain data according to their own privacy policies:

ServicePurposeData Involved
Alibaba DashScopePlant identification, health check, care advice, garden planning, voice intentPhotos (user-initiated), text prompts, transcribed voice, plant names
WeatherAPI.comWeather forecastsCoordinates, postal code, or IP
QWeather (Hefeng)Weather forecastsCoordinates, postal code, or location query

Google AdMobRewarded and app-open ads for free usersAdvertising identifiers, ad interaction data
Apple App Store / Google PlayIn-app subscriptions and purchasesPurchase receipts (handled by Apple/Google)
Meta (optional)Facebook sharing via system share sheetOnly when you choose to share content to Facebook

Links to third-party privacy policies:

  • Google Privacy Policy
  • Firebase Privacy
  • Alibaba Cloud Legal
  • Apple Privacy
  • Meta Data Policy

9. Advertising

Free users may see advertisements served by Google AdMob, including rewarded video ads and app-open ads. AdMob may use device advertising identifiers and interaction data to serve and measure ads, in accordance with Google’s policies.

On iOS, HortiWise may participate in Apple’s SKAdNetwork for ad attribution. You can limit ad tracking through your device settings (e.g., “Limit Ad Tracking” on iOS or advertising settings on Android).

10. Analytics and Crash Reporting

We use Firebase Analytics to understand how features are used and improve the App. Events may include, for example:

  • Onboarding completion
  • Paywall views and purchase events
  • Plant identification and health check usage
  • Home screen interactions

We use Firebase Crashlytics to collect crash reports and fatal errors so we can fix stability issues. Crash reports may include device model, OS version, and stack traces.

These analytics are processed by Google Firebase, not stored on HortiWise servers. You can learn more at Firebase Privacy.

11. Permissions

CameraCapture plant photos for identification, health checks, and journals
Photo LibrarySelect existing plant photos
Location (while in use)Fetch local weather for watering and care suggestions

NotificationsLocal care reminders and task alerts

Permission descriptions shown in the App match the use cases above.

12. Children’s Privacy

HortiWise is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us information, please contact us at vomiv523@gmail.com.

13. Data Retention

13.1 Local Data

Your garden data remains on your device until you:

  • Delete individual plants or journal entries
  • Uninstall the App
  • Reset or replace your device

13.2 Third-Party Processing

  • DashScope: Processes photos and text temporarily for AI features; retention is subject to Alibaba Cloud’s policies.
  • Weather providers: Process location queries to return forecasts; we do not control their retention periods.
  • Firebase / AdMob: Retain analytics, crash, and ad data per Google’s policies.

We do not maintain long-term copies of your garden content on HortiWise servers.

14. Your Rights and Choices

Depending on your region, you may have rights regarding your personal information. Because HortiWise stores most data locally:

  • Access and deletion: You can view and delete plants, journals, and photos within the App, or remove all App data by uninstalling.
  • Location: You can deny location permission and enter a postal code instead, or clear location settings in the App.
  • AI features: You control when photos are sent by choosing whether to tap Identify or Health Check.
  • Analytics and ads: You may limit ad tracking and analytics through your device or platform settings.
  • Contact us: For privacy requests, email vomiv523@gmail.com.

If you are in the European Economic Area or California, you may have additional rights under GDPR or CCPA. Contact us and we will respond within a reasonable time.

15. International Data Transfers

When you use AI or weather features, your data may be processed in countries other than your own. DashScope servers may be located in jurisdictions such as China, Singapore, or the United States. We use secure transmission (HTTPS) for all network requests.

16. Security

HortiWise implements:

  • Local storage for garden data and photos
  • Secure HTTPS communication with third-party APIs
  • API keys stored in secure device storage, not hard-coded in the App binary

Your data security also depends on your device settings (passcode, biometrics, OS updates, and backup practices).

17. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on this page. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

18. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at:

Email: vomiv523@gmail.com

Your privacy is our priority. HortiWise keeps your garden on your device, uses location only for weather, and sends photos to AI only when you ask.
